SELECT user_id, target_id, target_type, SUM(score) AS total_score FROM ( SELECT user_id, target_id, target_type, CASE WHEN browse_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 1.5 WHEN browse_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.4 END AS score -- 浏览行为加入时间衰减，近期兴趣权重更高。 FROM t_browse_history WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT t1.user_id, t2.game_id AS target_id, 'game' as target_type, CASE WHEN t1.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 3.0 WHEN t1.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 180 DAY) THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.0 END AS score -- 评论说明用户对关联游戏有更强兴趣。 FROM t_comment t1, t_post t2 WHERE #{targetType} = 'game' AND t1.post_id = t2.id AND t2.game_id IS NOT NULL AND (t1.deleted = 0 OR t1.deleted IS NULL) AND (t2.deleted = 0 OR t2.deleted IS NULL) AND (t2.audit_status = 'approved' OR t2.audit_status IS NULL OR t2.audit_status = '')
UNION ALL
SELECT user_id, game_id AS target_id, 'game' AS target_type, 6 AS score -- 已购买游戏属于强偏好。 FROM t_order WHERE #{targetType} = 'game' AND status = '购买成功' AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT user_id, game_id AS target_id, 'game' AS target_type, CASE WHEN recommend = 0 THEN 0.5 WHEN rating >= 9 THEN 5.0 WHEN rating >= 7 THEN 4.0 ELSE 2.0 END AS score -- 好评和高分评价权重更高，差评仅保留弱兴趣。 FROM t_game_rating WHERE #{targetType} = 'game' ) AS combined_data GROUP BY user_id, target_id, target_type
